'''Neyla Hawkins''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A sister of [[Mia Hawkins]], both were members of the [[Eagle's network]], which in truth was the proxy of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Jadus]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]] Mia deserted from the [[Ghost cell]] section of the organization and contacted the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] to save her life. She helped [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] in bringing the Ghost Cell down, with Nine later murdering the [[Eagle]] himself. His organization destroyed, the Empire began systematically hunting down the remaining terrorists. Neyla found her refuge from the Empire in joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], she tracked down Cipher Nine with a tip from [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter]] and cornered them in the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Military History Museum]]. She had the Cipher disarmed and on their knees at gunpoint, but the Agent managed to fight back and kill her.
